summary.text: Mike Porfirio is a Democratic member of the Illinois State Senate from District 11, in office since January 2023, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Naval Academy graduate who has served in the Navy and Navy Reserve, he chairs the Veterans Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Porfirio was born in Bridgeview, Illinois, and has served with the U.S. Navy and U.S. Navy Reserve.
He earned a B.S. in history from the United States Naval Academy, an M.A. in political science from Purdue University, and an M.B.A. from the University of Illinois at Chicago.

His career experience includes working as director of public works of the Village of Bridgeview, and he has served as a trustee of Lyons Township, chairman of the Justice-Willow Springs Water Commission, and village administrator of the Village of Summit.
Porfirio assumed office in the Illinois State Senate on January 11, 2023, succeeding Celina Villanueva (D), and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Veterans Affairs Committee, vice-chair of the Transportation Committee, and a member of the Appropriations - Public Safety and Infrastructure, Education, Senate Higher Education, and Labor committees.
